declarations.description:
Controller headless de CRUD *local-first* com persistência em múltiplas fontes.

O navegador (adaptador local: IndexedDB, memória…) é o primeiro passo / cache e os
adaptadores remotos (Google Drive, OneDrive, REST…) são a persistência final. O
controller mantém as duas coerentes:

- **delete** = o registro deixa de existir em **todas** as fontes. Ordem: marca uma
  *lápide* local (`pending-delete`, some da lista na hora) → apaga em cada remoto →
  só então apaga o local. Se um remoto falhar, a lápide fica e `retryPending()`
  tenta de novo (o registro nunca "ressuscita" e o arquivo remoto nunca fica órfão);
- **create/update** gravam localmente e, conforme `autoSync`/`sync()`, enviam aos remotos;
- cada registro carrega `syncState` e `remotes` (onde está persistido).

Extensível via herança (`extends FzlCrudBaseController<T>`) pelos hooks protegidos
`createId`, `beforeCreate`, `beforeUpdate`, `beforeDelete`, `deleteRemote`,
`deleteLocal`, `afterDelete`, `onPartialFailure`, `onSynced`, `onSyncError`,
`isUnsynced` e `toRow`.
declarations.name: FzlCrudBaseController

members.description: Visible records (tombstones excluded).

Returns the unbind function.

members.name: load
members.description: Loads the records from the local adapter (and retries pending work if configured).

members.name: attachRemote
members.description:
Records that the record is persisted remotely, for apps that send it through their own
pipeline instead of `sync()`. Replaces (or adds) the ref of the same provider and marks
the record `synced`, so `delete()` reaches the remote copy. When the record does not exist
it is created from `data` (e.g. a file that only exists in the cloud). Tombstones and
records with an operation in progress are left untouched (`null`).

members.name: putLocal
members.description:
Changes only the local data (e.g. the saved binary of an existing document) without
touching `syncState` or `remotes`. Tombstones and busy records are left untouched (`null`).

members.name: sync
members.description:
Sends a record to the remotes (default: every remote it is already in, or every
configured remote when it was never sent). Existing refs are updated, new ones created.

members.name: delete
members.description:
Deletes from **every** persistence source (remote first, then local).
Records whose remote deletion fails stay as `pending-delete` tombstones.

members.name: retryPending

type.text: Promise<{ deleted: string[]; pending: string[]; synced: string[] }>

members.description:
Retries the pending work: tombstones (`pending-delete`) and records changed after
their last sync (`dirty`) or whose sync failed (`error`) that already have remotes.

members.description: Validate/transform before creating; `false` cancels.

members.name: beforeUpdate
members.description: Validate/transform before updating; `false` cancels.

members.name: beforeDelete
members.description: Gate before deleting (e.g. a dialog that says the file also leaves Google Drive).

members.name: deleteRemote
members.description: Deletes one remote copy. Default: the adapter's `delete()`.

members.name: deleteLocal
members.description: Deletes the local copy. Default: the local adapter's `delete()`.

members.name: onPartialFailure
members.description: A remote deletion failed; the record stays as a tombstone.

members.name: isUnsynced
members.description:
Whether a record would be lost (or leave an orphan remotely) if the local data were
purged now. Default: every state but `synced`.

declarations.description:
Controller headless que isola os dados locais (IndexedDB e `Storage`) por usuário
e aplica a política de limpeza no logout.

Cada usuário recebe um *escopo* (`fzl-ud:<appId>:<hash do usuário>`): todo banco
IndexedDB e toda chave de storage aberta por este controller carrega esse prefixo,
então trocar de usuário — mesmo sem logout (aba fechada, token expirado) — nunca
mostra os dados do anterior. No logout a política (`keep` | `purge` | `ask`) decide
se os dados do escopo que saiu são apagados.

Extensível via herança (`extends FzlUserDataController`) pelos hooks protegidos
`resolveUserScope`, `toIdentity`, `countUnsynced`, `shouldPurgeOnLogout`,
`confirmPurge`, `onBeforePurge`, `onAfterPurge` e `onUserChanged`.

Records audio from the microphone with MediaRecorder, shows a live input level
meter (Web Audio API), supports pause/resume and a maximum duration, and — by
default — **persists every finished recording's audio Blob in the browser's
IndexedDB**. Saved recordings are listed in a built-in library with playback,
download and delete.

Set `storage="none"` to disable persistence and only receive the
`fzl-audio-captured` event.
declarations.name: FzlAudioCapture

may be injected (useful for tests).

Document Reader (`fzl-document-reader`).

Generic reader for long text: renders plain `text` or `blocks`
(compatible with `FzlDocxReaderController.blocks`) in a scrollable area that fills
the host, with a thin toolbar (title, font size, reading width, fullscreen) and an
`actions` slot for app buttons.

Fullscreen uses the Fullscreen API on the host; where it is not available
(e.g. iPhone Safari) it falls back to an "immersive" CSS overlay (fixed, 100vw × 100dvh)
that closes with Esc.

Offsets: the canonical plain text of the document is the block texts joined by
`'\n\n'` (see `readerPlainText`, available as `reader.plainText`).

Mobile-friendly Reader Selection & Highlight Toolbar Component.

Designed to prevent UX conflicts with mobile/Android OS touch-to-search panels,
system gesture areas, and native copy popovers by offering 3 ergonomic modes:

Provides a filesystem-like file explorer indicating whether files are
local favorites (`bookmarked-only`), remote on server (`uploaded-only`),

filter by status, and seamlessly resume reading with support for native DOCX,
Markdown, TXT, PDF, JSON, and CSV.

declarations.description:
Enterprise Social Login Web Component (`fzl-social-login`).

Provides client-side social authentication with public Google and Microsoft accounts,
with zero required backend dependencies. Supports both direct OAuth2 / OpenID Connect
and an automatic realistic demo fallback for rapid development and design system catalog.
declarations.name: FzlSocialLogin
